title: Six to Ten, and the Character That Was Already Here
label: ch:zh-count-ten
canDo: I can say, hear, read and write the Mandarin numbers one to ten with their tones, and write the five characters this chapter adds.

payoff.summary: Five characters and twelve strokes finish a run the book abandoned at five seventeen chapters earlier -- with 八 set against 人, and 十 finally taught on its own after thirteen chapters inside 早.
